rationale: Both documents name Raman et al., 2026 explicitly, identify it as describing the same task via a "think/don't-think" attention instruction drawn from WorkspaceBench's directed_modulation items, and frame the submitted method as deliberately different (a memory remember/forget contrast built from self-written prompts) while also surfacing the verb-invariant axis finding as the key novel insight.
